source_bounded_claim: Procurement and early rollout of NHS chest-diagnostic AI; 51 interviewees, 57 observed activities and 166 analysed documents. Three in-depth network contracts were signed in March, May and September 2024, later than anticipated.
inference_boundary: Observed tenders, contracting and launch timelines; no source-supported assertion that vendors were sanctioned for breaches.
next_primary_check: Signed contracts and dated award files, supplier-specific terms and any documented compliance notices.

source_bounded_claim: Qualitative interviews with 19 city employees in seven U.S. cities; descriptions of tender, selection, contracting and oversight, including lower-cost procurement bypassing some stages.
inference_boundary: Employee interviews demonstrate reported practices, not direct independent copies of each contract or a proven exercise of a vendor penalty.
next_primary_check: Match original solicitations, signed contract clauses and dated notice or remedy documentation.

source_bounded_claim: Survey using 104 questionnaires and PLS-SEM connects digital sourcing governance, risk awareness and reported supplier performance in a public-sector setting.
inference_boundary: Associations in questionnaire model are not a contractual remedy event or identified causal supplier performance impact.
next_primary_check: Inspect exact sample frame, item-level measurement, supplier contracts, and outcome operationalization.

source_bounded_claim: Indian public-sector AI procurement study develops structural model from literature and expert consultation, identifying 14 critical success factors.
inference_boundary: A factor model and expert priorities are not observed signed AI procurement outcomes or oversight enforcement.
next_primary_check: Acquire original methods and expert selection; verify relation to actual purchaser-vendor case records.

source_bounded_claim: Exploratory study of public procurement practitioners in Kenya and Uganda identifies gaps in AI procurement expertise and proposes human-centred procurement framework.
inference_boundary: Practitioner concerns and recommended governance are not verified executed contract provisions.
next_primary_check: Read complete participant/method protocol and look for specific AI contracts and post-award monitoring.

source_bounded_claim: Perspective synthesizes cross-sector stakeholder workshop on NHS AI procurement framework design; recommends documentation, KPIs, and vendor due diligence.
inference_boundary: Recommendations and stakeholder workshop are not a measured procurement intervention or documented exercise of supplier audit rights.
next_primary_check: Cross-check cited stroke programme for actual signed agreements and KPI reporting.

source_bounded_claim: Survey of representatives of 28 Canadian municipal AI projects contrasts in-house development versus outsourcing and six influencing factors.
inference_boundary: Reported outsourcing decisions do not establish purchase for all 28 projects or document exercised contract remedies.
next_primary_check: Examine each project procurement route and source documentation, avoid attributing outsourced status to in-house cases.

source_bounded_claim: Indexed abstract says 40 experts and 15 public-sector AI projects in UAE; groups risk factors in procurement and technology categories.
inference_boundary: Secondary bibliographic abstract does not verify original methods or individual purchase/monitoring documentation.
next_primary_check: Obtain publisher Methods or author original full text; verify 15-case denominator, vendor contracts and source study units.
